name: Speaker Labels
description: Tells who is speaking when, so interviews and conversations come out with each line labelled by speaker.
details: pyannote segmentation-3.0 finds active speakers in overlapping 10 s windows and 3D-Speaker ERes2Net fingerprints each voice; Drift clusters the fingerprints to match voices across the whole recording. The ONNX exports are the ones published by sherpa-onnx. Package id: diarize.pyannote-eres2net.
author: CutWire
